Gate may open as early as 1:00 p.m. with on-track sessions beginning at 3:00 p.m. There are no helmet rentals available at this event, please be certain your helmet meets the SCCA specifications. blurb: Blackhawk Farms is a 1.95 mile, 7 turn private circuit racetrack located in South Beloit, Illinois on 216 acres. The track is on the border between Wisconsin and Illinois, within 90 miles of 2 major metropolitan areas; Chicago and Milwaukee and minutes from interstate 90.
